description: Election Commission - Declare that A. D. Fairoos as a member of the Kattankudy Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
